Use case: ui-mockup
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Produce ONE finished mobile app home screen for the Korean focus companion app 작은 집중방. Direction name for your understanding only: 포근한 셀 애니메이션. Do not print a concept title or option number.
Target dimensions: 390 x 844 logical pixels, portrait aspect ratio; render sharply at high resolution. App content only, edge to edge. No device bezel, phone body, notch, OS status bar, clock, battery indicator, browser chrome, device mask or shadow. No collage or alternative screens.
References: first attached image is the current working app home: preserve its product purpose, red panda study companion identity and core functions, but redesign the entire visual system as unified hand-inked 2D animation. Second attached image is character identity inspiration only, not a layout target: preserve orange fur, white facial markings, large round dark brown eyes with visible sclera/highlights, striped tail and dark green overalls. Do not borrow the reference's headings, panel numbers or multiple poses.
Primary screen: inviting focus setup, one primary action. Warm cream paper surface, cocoa outlines, moss green and apricot accents. Clean flat cel shading with at most two tonal steps, softly imperfect rounded ink lines. No photorealism, no 3D render, no glossy toy, no textured fur rendering. Everything including furniture, icons, duration controls, CTA and navigation must feel drawn by the same animation art team.
Layout: warm header top left "나의 책상", subtitle "오늘도 같이 시작해요", small sound icon upper right. Center a generous front-facing cartoon room scene: red panda seated behind wooden desk writing in an open notebook, big green plants, bookcase, bright window and soft sunlight shapes. Recompose from the isometric reference into a flatter 2D animation stage. Scene blends naturally into the cream UI surface; no illustration in a separate card. Keep wide margins. Below scene one unboxed line "오늘의 집중" and "50분". Then a simple illustrated rounded segmented duration selector "25분" selected and "50분", a quiet secondary text action "랜덤 선택". One generously sized green filled hand-drawn button reading "집중 시작" with small play icon. Bottom nav: hand-drawn desk, calendar and gear icons with labels "책상", "기록", "설정"; desk selected. All text must be legible accurate Korean with rounded bold Korean sans typography. No more than two typefaces. Body text 14-16 logical px, headline ~28. CTA fully visible above nav.
Do not add features, extra cards, badges, currency, quests, dashboards or metrics. Prioritize spacing, grouping, alignment and typography; avoid nested cards. Current date anchor 2026-10-08, do not display a calendar/date. Calm companionship, animation-ready simplified linework, professionally polished usable app.
